MLI.note: The article is about a survey data release and states no open data policy.

facts.fact: FAO says Mali's statistics institute INSTAT and the rural development sector's planning unit CPS/SDR published the 2023-24 agricultural survey results, with interactive tables on Mali's national open data portal and microdata at microdata.instat.ml.
facts.system: Mali national open data portal (mali.opendataforafrica.org) and INSTAT microdata catalogue (microdata.instat.ml)
